# Go observer replay fixture

`version-cleanup.log` was generated by actual execution of the offline test:

    GOTELEMETRY=off go test -tags 'nogui nativecodex' ./internal/nativepreview -run '^TestRuntimePreparationDiagnosticsObserveOriginalCalls/version-cleanup$' -v -count=1

The isolated test uses an inert authored executable file, a fake unsuccessful
version callback, and a fake cleanup failure. It does not execute that file,
perform network/UI actions, or read user native state. Running this subtest alone
establishes process-local attempt 1. The standard Go logger emits the protocol.

Only its fixed protocol records were retained. Their date/time prefix was
normalized to `2000/01/01 00:00:00`; stage names, outcomes, attempt and sequence
bytes are unchanged. No unrelated log text or error bodies are included.

The 16-record trace demonstrates same-name nested runtime discovery and a
runtime-version failure followed by separately observed probe cleanup failure,
then the outer Connect failure. It is not runtime acceptance evidence.
